text:
maria (product_designer): quick follow-up from design review — a few compliance-panel micro-nits before we flip the feature. keeping this tight: retention wording, region-default affordance, KMS/encrypt badge clarity, audit export columns, a11y bits.

sam (devex): 👍 paste of the current audit sample would help so i can grep.

maria (product_designer): current audit log example: `User updated retention policy for workspace X to 90 days (was 30)` — feels verbose and inconsistent. propose: `Retention changed from 30 days to 90 days by rebecca (UI)`. compact table variant: `Retention: 30d → 90d — rebecca (UI)`. thoughts?

ben (docs): i like the sentence form for human logs — `Retention changed from 30 days to 90 days by rebecca (UI)` — it's search-friendly.

arjun (eng-platform): short events are nicer for table layout. backend should keep structured fields (actor, method, resource_id) so the UI can render friendly text but exports stay structured.

linda (security): audit payload must include actor and method (UI/API). also add a severity flag for destructive actions (info/warning/critical).

ethan (a11y): retention select currently shows `30, 60, 90` with no units. screen readers read numbers only. please change visible options to `30 days`, `60 days`, `90 days` and set `aria-label=\"Data retention period\"`. compact views can use `30d` but ensure each has `aria-label` linking to full text.

miguel (frontend): easy enough. i'll add i18n keys: `retention.expanded.30 = \"30 days\"` and `retention.compact.30 = \"30d\"` and wire aria-label to the expanded key.

maria (product_designer): region-default affordance: product wants an org-level default. security prefers a visible control. engineering wants less clutter. compromise: visible inline toggle `Make this the default region for new resources (Org admins only)` with a small `?` tooltip linking to org defaults page.

linda (security): keep it discoverable. require Org Admin role to flip, and show a confirmation if changing org default with a short note `Affects only new resources`.

arjun (eng-platform): note for infra: changing org-level default shouldn't trigger migrations or re-residency of existing resources. clarify in tooltip.

ethan (a11y): tooltip trigger must be keyboard-focusable and the tooltip itself should have `role=\"tooltip\"` and be connected with `aria-describedby`. avoid color-only indicators.

maria (product_designer): KMS/encryption badge: customers confuse `KMS` label. propose table pill `Encrypted (Platform)` vs `Encrypted (BYOK)`; detail view shows `Platform-managed key` and `Customer-managed key (Bring Your Own Key)` with a link `Learn about key ownership`. add lock icon `aria-hidden=true` and accessible text like `Encryption type: Customer-managed key`.

linda (security): BYOK enable flow must include a modal with explicit warning and required checkbox `I understand BYOK responsibilities and potential data unrecoverability`. log `BYOKEnabled` audit event with actor and workspace id.

miguel (frontend): will implement pill variants + modal. note: BYOK pill colors need higher contrast — current blue fails 4.5:1. i'll pick darker shade and add visible focus outline.

ben (docs): tooltip short strings: `Platform-managed key (Redwood)` and `Customer-managed key (You manage this key)`. modal short: `If you delete or revoke your key, data encrypted with it may become unrecoverable.` i'll update KB.

maria (product_designer): audit CSV export: customers want structured columns: `event_type, field_changed, old_value, new_value, actor, method, resource_id, severity, timestamp, meta_json`. ensure meta_json optional and permissioned.

linda (security): exports must be gated to `org_admin` or `compliance_officer` roles. meta_json must be redacted for PII by default. add audit event `AuditExportDownloaded` recording user and filters.

arjun (eng-platform): engineering note: include structured fields in the export so analysts don't have to parse freeform strings. meta_json can be a stringified JSON column. will surface in API.

sam (devex): i'll add unit tests for select labels and update i18n keys. also split compact vs expanded keys so translators have context.

ethan (a11y): small nit: don't use `learn more` alone as link text when it appears by itself — use `Learn about key ownership`. also ensure the confirmation modals are keyboard accessible and focus-trapped.

maria (product_designer): final copy nit: confirmation modal when reducing retention currently says `Are you sure?` — change to: primary `Change retention to 90 days for Workspace X?` secondary: `Messages older than 90 days may be permanently deleted. Review data lifecycle docs.` require a checkbox `I understand this may permanently delete messages older than the new retention period` for destructive changes.

linda (security): agree — require explicit confirmation for shrink actions and log `RetentionReducedConfirmed`.

miguel (frontend): will implement the modal with disabled primary until checkbox is checked. adding analytics hooks `retention_change_requested` and `retention_change_confirmed`.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to staging at 2026-04-15T06:00:00Z for `compliance-panel/v2` :rocket:

maria (product_designer): action items: miguel add i18n keys + pills + modal, sam test a11y labels, ben update docs and KB, linda review export redaction + BYOK wording, arjun confirm export schema and API. i'll upload updated artboards and exact strings in this thread when ready. thanks! :seedling:
